questions.question: As long as Uzziah sought the LORD, what happened?
What sin led to Uzziah being struck with leprosy?
options: Setting up many idols in all of the high places throughout the land
Entering the temple to burn incense, which was the priests' duty
Stealing the gold and silver from the temple treasury
Shedding much innocent blood throughout the whole city
questions.answer: Entering the temple to burn incense, which was the priests' duty

questions.question: Uzziah was a leper until the day of his death and lived in a separate house.
When Uzziah became powerful, his _____ led to his own destruction.
The leprosy broke out on Uzziah's _____ as he stood at the altar.
